findings.title: Red Hat CVE-2026-98432 customer portal entry
findings.summary_md: Red Hat rates CVE-2026-98432 as a Moderate-severity use-after-free in the Linux kernel IPv4 networking subsystem affecting RHEL 8, 9, and 10 (including Real Time kernel); RHEL 7 is not affected. The CVE page scores it 5.9 while Red Hat's machine-readable advisory later lists Important impact and 8.1, and the public date is October 15, 2026. Fixes were deferred to a future update as of October 29, 2026.

findings.title: Amazon Linux ALAS CVE-2026-98432 entry
findings.summary_md: Amazon Linux lists CVE-2026-98432 with Important severity and a CVSS v3 base score of 7.0, made public on October 15, 2026 and modified on October 16, 2026. Fixed packages include kernel6.18 on October 24, 2026 (ALAS2023-2026-3251) and kernel6.12 on October 29, 2026 (ALAS2023-2026-3335), while other packages remained pending.

findings.title: OSV entry for CVE-2026-98432
findings.summary_md: The OSV record for CVE-2026-98432 was published on October 15, 2026 at 12:08:22 UTC and summarizes the issue as ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period in the Linux kernel. It carries a CVSS v3 score of 9.8 with vector AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H and lists downstream packages across Amazon Linux, Debian, openSUSE, and Ubuntu.

findings.title: Anthropic research post on Claude-found vulnerabilities
findings.summary_md: Anthropic reported that an unreleased internal Claude model found and exploited CVE-2026-98432, a race-condition use-after-free in the Linux kernel networking stack. The exploit targets servers with a multipath TCP listener, leaks a kernel pointer in about 48 minutes, and reaches root command execution about 5 minutes later. The vulnerability was patched upstream and backported to all maintained stable kernel branches.

findings.title: The Hacker News coverage of Anthropic's exploit chains
findings.summary_md: The Hacker News covered Anthropic's October 27 research post on October 28, 2026, noting that the unreleased model built working exploit chains for Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows, and Linux. For the Linux case it described a zero-click remote root exploit via multipath TCP using CVE-2026-98432, with all flaws already patched after coordinated disclosure.
